Skill.Name: Air Magic
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Improves spells belonging to the Air school.

Skill.Name: Archery
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases the base damage of ranged attacks.

Skill.Name: Armorer
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Reduces physical damage received; spell damage is unaffected. Original siege arrow towers have a bug that reverses this benefit.

Skill.Name: Artillery
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Allows manual control of the Ballista and defensive arrow towers.

Skill.Name: Attack
Skill.Description: Primary skill. Added to the Attack rating of creatures commanded by the hero.

Skill.Name: Ballistics
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Allows manual targeting of the Catapult during sieges.

Skill.Name: Defense
Skill.Description: Primary skill. Added to the Defense rating of creatures commanded by the hero.

Skill.Name: Diplomacy
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Improves negotiations with wandering monsters and reduces surrender costs. Joining also depends on army strength and monster disposition.

Skill.Name: Eagle Eye
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. After victory, may learn eligible spells used by the enemy hero. Wisdom still limits which spell levels can be learned.

Skill.Name: Earth Magic
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Improves spells belonging to the Earth school.

Skill.Name: Estates
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Produces daily gold for the owner.

Skill.Name: Fire Magic
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Improves spells belonging to the Fire school.

Skill.Name: First Aid
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Allows manual control of the First Aid Tent. Healing repairs the surviving top creature without resurrecting casualties.

Skill.Name: Intelligence
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases the normal mana maximum derived from Knowledge.

Skill.Name: Knowledge
Skill.Description: Primary skill. Each point supplies 10 base maximum spell points; Intelligence and other bonuses can increase this amount.

Skill.Name: Leadership
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Raises the morale modifier of eligible troops.

Skill.Name: Learning
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases experience awarded to the hero.

Skill.Name: Logistics
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases base daily land movement before separate flat movement bonuses.

Skill.Name: Luck
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Raises the luck modifier of the army.

Skill.Name: Mysticism
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases daily mana regeneration; the listed value is the total, replacing the normal 1 point per day.

Skill.Name: Navigation
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases base daily movement while sailing.

Skill.Name: Necromancy
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Raises Skeletons after a victorious battle. Casualty count, casualty HP and available army slots constrain the result; artifacts can alter the raised creature.

Skill.Name: Offense
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases the base damage of melee attacks.

Skill.Name: Pathfinding
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Reduces extra movement cost on difficult terrain. The original game retains a floor of 100 points for a straight, off-road tile.

Skill.Name: Resistance
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Gives troops a chance to resist hostile magic.

Skill.Name: Scholar
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Exchanges spells when friendly heroes meet. Recipients need a spell book and sufficient Wisdom.

Skill.Name: Scouting
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Extends the hero's sight radius on the adventure map.

Skill.Name: Sorcery
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Increases spell damage in combat.

Skill.Name: Spell Power
Skill.Description: Primary skill, also called Power. Determines the strength and duration of spells that scale with the caster.

Skill.Name: Tactics
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Allows troop placement before combat; opposing Tactics mastery subtracts from this advantage.

Skill.Name: Water Magic
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Improves spells belonging to the Water school.

Skill.Name: Wisdom
Skill.Description: Secondary skill. Allows higher-level spells to be learned. Spells already known or granted by artifacts can be cast without the corresponding Wisdom level.

Spell.Name: Air Shield
Spell.Description: Reduces damage from ranged attacks. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Animate Dead
Spell.Description: Restores casualties in one allied undead stack. Restored creatures remain after combat at every mastery level.

Spell.Name: Anti-Magic
Spell.Description: Protects one friendly stack from spells within the covered levels; Dispel can remove the protection. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Armageddon
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages every susceptible stack on the battlefield, including allies.

Spell.Name: Berserk
Spell.Description: Affected creatures attack their nearest available stack, including allies. Ends after one attack.

Spell.Name: Bless
Spell.Description: Forces high base attack damage and counters Curse. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Blind
Spell.Description: Disables one eligible enemy stack until it is attacked, dispelled, or the duration expires. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Bloodlust
Spell.Description: Attack for melee attacks modifier. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Chain Lightning
Spell.Description: Instant lightning attack that jumps between stacks, including allies. Each jump halves the preceding damage.

Spell.Name: Clone
Spell.Description: Creates a copy of one friendly stack; any damage destroys the copy. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Counterstrike
Spell.Description: Grants extra retaliations each combat round. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Cure
Spell.Description: Instantly removes harmful spell effects and heals the injured surviving creature; does not resurrect casualties.

Spell.Name: Curse
Spell.Description: Forces low base attack damage and counters Bless. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Death Ripple
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages non-undead creature stacks on both sides, including non-living creatures; war machines are immune.

Spell.Name: Destroy Undead
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages every undead stack on both sides.

Spell.Name: Dimension Door
Spell.Description: Teleports the hero to a valid nearby map square. Untrained casting is limited to once daily; mastery raises the limit.

Spell.Name: Disguise
Spell.Description: Changes enemy scouting reports of the casting hero's army for the current day.

Spell.Name: Dispel
Spell.Description: Instantly removes dispellable spell effects, whether helpful or harmful.

Spell.Name: Disrupting Ray
Spell.Description: Defense reduction lasts until combat ends. Repeated casts accumulate; Cure and Dispel do not remove it.

Spell.Name: Earthquake
Spell.Description: Instant siege spell that damages fortifications, including arrow towers.

Spell.Name: Fire Shield
Spell.Description: Damages melee attackers of one protected friendly stack. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Fire Wall
Spell.Description: Creates a damaging wall that lasts two rounds. Uses the original 10 * Spell Power damage coefficient.

Spell.Name: Fireball
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages stacks in the selected hex and its six neighboring hexes, including allies.

Spell.Name: Fly
Spell.Description: Allows travel over water and obstacles for the current day, ending on an allowed landing square.

Spell.Name: Force Field
Spell.Description: Creates an impassable barrier for two combat rounds.

Spell.Name: Forgetfulness
Spell.Description: Suppresses ranged attacks and halves melee contribution. Original-game behavior makes Advanced mass-targeting, matching Expert. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Fortune
Spell.Description: Luck modifier. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Frenzy
Spell.Description: Converts Defense into an Attack bonus until the target's action turn in the next round.

Spell.Name: Frost Ring
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages stacks in the six hexes surrounding the selected hex, including allies; the center is spared.

Spell.Name: Haste
Spell.Description: Speed modifier. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Hypnotize
Spell.Description: Temporarily controls an enemy stack. The HP test uses the surviving creature count at full individual health. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Ice Bolt
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages one selected enemy stack.

Spell.Name: Implosion
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages one selected enemy stack.

Spell.Name: Inferno
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages stacks within two hexes of the selected hex, including allies; up to 19 hexes.

Spell.Name: Land Mine
Spell.Description: Places hidden mines until triggered. Enemy creatures on their native terrain can see and safely cross the mines.

Spell.Name: Lightning Bolt
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages one selected stack.

Spell.Name: Magic Arrow
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages one selected enemy stack.

Spell.Name: Magic Mirror
Spell.Description: May redirect an eligible hostile spell targeting the protected stack to a random enemy stack. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Meteor Shower
Spell.Description: Instant damage spell. Damages stacks in the selected hex and its six neighboring hexes, including allies.

Spell.Name: Mirth
Spell.Description: Morale modifier. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Misfortune
Spell.Description: Luck modifier. Lasts one combat round per point of Spell Power unless removed earlier.

Spell.Name: Prayer
